Here is your complete Racing Bar Chart project showing CO2 emissions by country from 2014 to 2023. The visualization uses D3.js to create an animated racing bar chart where countries compete by their annual CO2 emissions (in million metric tons). Key features:

- Horizontal bars sorted by emission value, with the highest emitter on top
- Smooth D3 transitions as country rankings change between years
- Country labels inside bars and emission values at bar ends
- Current year displayed as a large watermark
- Dark theme with configurable colors, bar dimensions, and animation speed
- Self-animating playback that cycles through all 10 years with play/pause control

Data sourced from the Global Carbon Budget 2024, Worldometer/EDGAR, and Our World in Data. The dataset covers the top 10 CO2 emitting countries: China, United States, India, Russia, Japan, Germany, South Korea, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and Indonesia.
